question: cyIs your claim against trespassers?
hint: cyA trespasser is someone who entered or stayed in your property or land without your permission. Someone is not usually a trespasser if they had your permission to live there, even if you now want them to leave. For example, a tenant, contract holder or licensee.

options.yes: cyYes – my claim is against a trespasser who entered or stayed in my property or land without my permission
options.no: cyNo – my claim is against a tenant, contract holder or licensee

errors.isTrespass: cySelect whether your claim is against trespassers
